text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - Exporters reported sales of 112,000 tonnes of U.S. white white for delivery to Pakistan during the 1996/97 marketing year, USDA announced Friday.
CORN SALES - South Korea's Korea Corn Processing Industry Association bought 105,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow No.2 corn from Cargill at $139.60 a tonne C&F tradeers said on Friday.
- South African co-operatives were successful in selling 250,000 tonnes of yellow corn to Iran in the past week, Unie Graan co-operative chairman J Theron said in a statement.
RICE SALE - Jamaica bought 2,700 tonnes of U.S. long grain brown rice in bulk on Friday for May 20-June 5 shipment under the PL-480 donation program, its export agent said.

WHEAT TENDER - South Korea passed on tenders to buy 13,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat but bought 10,000 tonnes of Canadian western red spring wheat at $182.75 a tonne FOB from the Canadian Wheat Board through a private negotiation.
- Bulgaria was seeking 50,000 tonnes of wheat in exchange for exports from the new harvest.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat in two lots of 50,000 tonnes. Tenders close on May 16. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second lot was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
FLOUR TENDER - Yemen seeks 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour on May 13 for August/October shipment. The flour was expected to come from the EU, U.S., or both.
BARLEY TENDER - Cyprus seeks 25,000 tonnes of barley on May 13 for May/June shipment.
RAPESEED MEAL TENDER - South Korea passed on tenders to buy 31,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal.
SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea seeks 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybean on May 16. The bids would close on May 15.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal under the PL-480 export program for June 1-15, July 1-31 and/or August 1-31 delivery. Offers were to be submitted no later than May 12 and will be valid until May 13.

SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC was tendering on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment. CCC also seeks 2,000 tonnes refined U.S. sunflower seed oil for donation under its export program to Bosnia. Offers were due on May 13.
RICE TENDERS - Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery
...Costa Rican millers were privately negotiating for 26,500 tonnes of optional origin long grain rough rice, for June 30-July 7 shipment.

MARKET TALK - China will export a single shipment of 50,000 tonnes of corn to South Korea in the next few days, the largest such shipment since a ban on corn exports was lifted last year, an industry source said.
... Philippine flour mills, which this week announced the intention of buying 90,000 tonnes of wheat, are expected to clinch deals in the coming week on price dips, traders said.
